claims.claim_text: 約 0.001% 的查詢該有資料卻回傳空結果
claims.evidence: During the beta, our highest-volume MySQL customer reported a small but consistent rate of empty query responses for which a non-empty response was always expected. ... This error occurred about 0.001% of the time
claims.note: Rate supported; source ties it to the highest-volume MySQL customer's reports. Title 十萬分之一 equals 0.001%.

claims.claim_text: Cloudflare 宣布 Hyperdrive 的 MySQL 支援正式 GA
claims.evidence: Hyperdrive support for MySQL is now generally available (GA).

claims.claim_text: MySQL 的回應會依 Worker 是否支援 CLIENT_DEPRECATE_EOF 而被改寫，同一資料中心的快取因此混入了為別的節點編碼的位元組
claims.evidence: When CLIENT_DEPRECATE_EOF is negotiated, the metadata EOF packet is omitted ... This means rewriting result sets to include EOFs and to translate all OK packets to EOFs when required. ... that we can cache exactly the bytes we wrote back to the Worker
claims.note: Mechanism supported; the phrase 'same data center' was not surfaced in the fetched passages.

claims.claim_text: 修正後一律存入標準編碼版本，Client 連線成功率達 99.99%
claims.evidence: we always write back a canonical version of the query result bytes in the cache encoded using Hyperdrive’s capabilities ... our success rate for Client connections reached 99.99%.

claims.claim_text: 以 IETF 的 Media over QUIC（MoQ）取代自家的 RUSH 協定，邊緣端用暫時的轉換層把 MoQ 轉回 RUSH 格式，後端不必改動
claims.evidence: Instagram Live now uses the open standard transport protocol Media over QUIC (MoQ) ... a translation layer converts MoQ frames to the RUSH format the existing backend already understands.

claims.claim_text: Meta 說 MoQ 路徑在串流品質與可靠度指標上與 RUSH 持平，但文章沒有公布具體數字
claims.evidence: The MoQ path matched RUSH across the streaming-quality indicators and reliability measures used for the rollout.
claims.note: Fetched text confirms no specific figures published.

claims.claim_text: 每場直播開始時還會依哪個握手先成功，選擇 TCP 或 QUIC，以應付封鎖 UDP/443 的網路
claims.evidence: based on which handshake wins, and go with that for the session ... UDP/443 is still blocked or rate-limited on a non-trivial slice of enterprise and carrier networks.
claims.note: Choice is session-level at stream start.

claims.claim_text: 把 Git 放上物件儲存的做法被 S3 每次數十毫秒的往返拖住，WAL-on-S3 設計的寫入仍要序列化到單一索引與單一主機
claims.evidence: a conditional GET or PUT takes tens of milliseconds. ... All pushes to a repository go through one primary machine and one conditional PUT on the WAL index.
claims.note: Post attributes to the author's argument.

claims.claim_text: 自報單一儲存庫尖峰每秒 7,619 次 push。這些數字是作者自己的基準測試，文章也說明與其他系統的設定不同，尚未經獨立驗證
claims.evidence: Enroute takes 7,619 pushes per second into one repository. ... The Enroute and GitHub numbers are our own forgemark runs. ... come from slightly different setups but give a good sense on the order of magnitude
claims.note: Self-report hedge carried. The word 尖峰 (peak) not confirmed verbatim; not load-bearing.

claims.claim_text: 他的替代方案是帶共識的 ledger、無狀態運算層與以 commit 為單位的 segment 格式

claims.note: The word 'consensus' itself not seen verbatim; replicated ledger commit supported.

claims.claim_text: 每個資料庫由一個以 SQLite 為底的 Durable Object 支撐，查詢走資料平面，不經過中央 Postgres
